# Get Object of Class

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets an object with the defined class.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getClass(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, class: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getClass(input: ShortcutInput, class: "NSURL")
~~~~
